profile.Name: Crumblejon
profile.Personality: An old samurai whose life was his service. Formal, worn, and proud, with bitterness and fondness for the Empire in equal measure.
profile.Backstory: He served the United Cities as a famous samurai until his master died. Now he lives in Mongrel, as far from his old life as he could go. His old bones are brittle, hence his name.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Formal imperial speech, worn comfortable; occasional bitterness about the Empire.
